headline: The Trade Desk Stock Slumps After Revenue Misses Forecasts
summary: Shares of  The Trade Desk  slumped 22% in after hours trading after the  advertising technology company reported second quarter revenue that fell short of expectations.  The company reported adjusted earnings of 34 cents a share and revenue of $715 million, up 3% from a year ago.  Analysts tracked by FactSet expected adjusted earnings of 18 cents a share and revenue of $752.6 million.
